### Download
| | |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Slock-Windows.zip` — extract it, run `Slock/Slock.exe` |
| **Mac** | `Slock-Mac.zip` — extract it, then **right-click `Slock.app` → Open** (it isn't signed by Apple yet) |
| **Linux** | `Slock-Linux.tar.gz` — extract it, run `Slock/Slock.x86_64` |

### What's new
- **Brake.** Squeeze the right trigger to slow Slock, pull it all the way to hold it still. On the keyboard, hold **W**.
- **Look around.** The right stick slides the camera across the maze to see what's coming, and it eases back when you let go. With the mouse, hold **Space** and move it.
- **Walls burst.** A wall you break with a slug or Slock of Steel bursts into chips, dust and sparks.
- **Swurms leave slime** that dries up behind them, slide one tile at a time, and turn orange while they're carrying time they stole from you. Eat one to get it back.
- **Points pop up** ("+20") as you score, rippling up the screen.
- **Slock of Steel** now looks like the steel pickup: plates, rivets and all.

Early pre-release: Windows and Mac builds haven't been tried on real machines yet. If something breaks, please [open an issue](https://github.com/pixelhackstudios/slock/issues).
